title: 2.3ft  Portable Aluminum Folding Camping Table, Indoor Outdoor Lightweight Foldable Picnic Desk, 70-50cm Heavy Duty Small Fold Up Table
body_html:
2.3ft Portable Aluminum Folding Camping Table, Indoor Outdoor Lightweight Foldable Picnic Desk, 70-50cm Heavy Duty Small Fold Up Table

1.Perfect for camping, picnic, backyard & indoor use! This lightweight aluminum folding table features a smooth black fiberboard top, sturdy 16mm alloy legs, weather-resistant build, and easy foldable suitcase design for simple carry & storage. Supports up to 40kg load, quick wipe clean, no complex assembly needed.
2.Key Features
Durable Aluminum Alloy Frame – Rust-proof & withstand harsh weather for long service life
Smooth Black Tabletop – Easy to wipe clean with a damp cloth in seconds
Foldable Suitcase Design – Compact carry, space-saving storage after use
Multi-Scene Use – Works great for camping, picnic, patio, home study & market stall
Stable Heavy-Duty Build – Max 40kg load capacity, solid support for food, gear & supplies
Simple Setup – No tools required, unfold & ready to use instantly
3.Product Specs
Color: Black Tabletop
Material: Fiberboard Tabletop + 16mm Aluminum Alloy Tube Frame
Unfold Size: 70×50×60cm (27.56×19.69×23.62 inch)
Net Weight: 3.1kg / 6.83lbs
Max Load Bearing: 40kg / 88.18lbs
Package Content
1 × Portable Aluminum Folding Table
